We will score every pilot/module against five objective criteria—policy impact (e.g., GHG reduction or transit ridership), implementation readiness, cost‑effectiveness (CBO metrics), regional‑equity lift, and private‑leverage potential—and publish a scored, tiered prioritization (Tier 1 = protected/ready; Tier 2 = scalable; Tier 3 = discretionary) before the hearing.  
If joint CBO interaction scoring shows the overall package exceeds the agreed fiscal envelope, reductions will follow the tiering (Tier 3 first, then proportional scaling of Tier 2) unless title leads jointly agree and CBO‑score an alternative reallocation.  
For joint projects, the Seams Matrix will identify a single lead title for funding/credit; we will protect Tier 1 joint projects, and any necessary cuts to joint efforts will be applied by pre‑agreed proportional cost‑sharing among participating titles with a limited modernization contingency reserve used only for narrowly timed bridge needs.  
We commit to no retroactive clawbacks or shifting of obligations onto other titles—any transfer of responsibility or funding must be a transparent, signed inter‑title amendment and receive CBO scoring.  
We will publish the scored prioritization, scaling rules, contingency rules, and joint‑project cost‑share formulas prior to the hearing so members can see, in advance, how adjustments will preserve core climate, equity, and transit objectives.
